title: Microsoft Teams: organisers choose who controls production tools in meetings with presenters and webinars
notes: claim 72: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
claim 73: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The rollout facts, enabled-by-default statement and explicitly qualified town hall control path are supported. The impact rationale makes two unsupported claims about who sees the dropdown; Microsoft identifies production staff as affected, not necessarily as seeing the option. The licensing model also understates the published product-level entitlement.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because Microsoft has not published an entitlement specific to the new dropdown.
claims.quote: All eligible Teams licenses include the foundational capabilities needed to create and run events ... Advanced event features: These licenses provide the full Teams events feature set.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included', retaining the existing notes naming Office 365 E1, E3 and E5 and Microsoft 365 E3, E5 and E7 and the qualification that separate licensing for the dropdown is not specified. claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: impact

claims.where: rationale: impact
claims.claim: Designated production staff will see the new option in meeting options.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams production tools organizer meeting options visibility designated staff. Read MC1443520 and town hall Support: organisers see the option and staff are affected, but neither states that designated staff see the dropdown.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with: 'Medium. Organisers of meetings with presenters and webinars will see a new option in meeting options; Microsoft also identifies designated production staff as affected.'

claims.where: rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users other than organisers and designated production staff will not see the new option.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams production tools organizer meeting options visibility designated staff. Read MC1443520, town hall Support and Graph onlineMeetingBase: none establishes this exhaustive visibility rule for the new dropdown.
claims.fix: Remove 'other users will not' from the impact rationale; the replacement rationale in the preceding finding removes this unsupported visibility restriction.
